text:
Emily: Hi all :megaphone: — quick heads up: we have a short all-hands on Thursday 11:00am PST. Will cover a compliance policy update, launch callouts for the Dedicated rollout, and a Q&A. Please drop any questions here or add them to this one‑minute form: https://forms.gle/short-form-1

Sam: adding a question — how will data retention differ for prod vs dev environments?

Jia: also want clarity on KMS timeline and whether test clusters need keys before go‑live.

Emily: Great q's. Agenda draft: 1) 5m housekeeping + roadmap cadence 2) 10m compliance (data retention/KMS/HSM options) 3) 10m Dedicated launch callouts (SLA, burst policy, support flow) 4) 15m live Q&A 5) 5m next steps/actions. Please ping me if you'd like a 1‑minute slot in Q&A.

Matt: FYI we'll also include a short demo of the new rollout dashboard — 3 slides.

Emily: Logistics: meeting in Zoom link (calendar invite sent). We'll record. If you can't attend, the recording and a 2‑slide TL;DR will be posted in this thread afterwards.

Sam: can we get the compliance slides ahead of time? want to prep answers for customer questions.

Emily: yes — I'll drop the slide deck 30m before the meeting.

[meeting happens]

Ops Bot: Recording posted: https://meetings.redwood/recs/1717654321 — transcript available.

Matt: TL;DR from the session :memo: — 1) New data retention baseline: 90 days for dev logs, 365 days for production audit logs (policy ratified). 2) KMS opt‑in required for Dedicated customers by 2026‑06‑01; internal teams to enroll test clusters by 2026‑05‑20. 3) Dedicated launch: initial rollout in us‑west, canary to 10% traffic, automatic fallback to hosted models on error. 4) Support: use #support-dedicated and tag @oncall for Sev1.

Jia: noted — I'll update runbooks and post the checklist here: https://docs.redwood/checklists/dedicated-rollout

Emily: Actions captured: A) Send final slide deck (Emily) — done. B) Runbooks updated (Jia) — ETA 5/5. C) KMS enrollment guide + script (Infra team) — ETA 5/15. D) Customer comms draft (Growth) — ETA 5/20. If your team is an owner for any of these, reply here.

Sam: I'll own the customer comms draft and coordinate with Growth.

Jia: I own runbooks.

Emily: Awesome, thanks. If you missed the meeting — watch the recording and fill the short acknowledgement form: https://forms.gle/ack-1717654321 :white_check_mark:

Matt: leaving a link to the meeting notes and action tracker: https://docs.redwood/notes/allhands-1717654321

Emily: Closing — thanks everyone for quick turn around. We'll follow up in two weeks with rollout metrics and any policy clarifications. :rocket:
